weighing.label: Weighing performance
weighing.description: Test loads applied from zero up to Max and removed back to zero. At least 10 loads for the initial intrinsic error, 5 otherwise, including Min, Max and the loads at which the mpe changes.

eccentricity.label: Eccentricity
eccentricity.description: A load of one third of Max plus maximum additive tare applied in turn to each segment of the load receptor.

repeatability.label: Repeatability
repeatability.loadHint: Two series for type approval: about 50 % of Max and close to Max. One series at about 0.8 Max for verification.
repeatability.description: The same load applied repeatedly; the difference between results must not exceed the MPE for that load.

discrimination.label: Discrimination
discrimination.description: An additional load of 1.4 d, gently deposited at equilibrium, must change the indication unambiguously by one actual scale interval.

tare.label: Tare device
tare.description: Net results are evaluated against the MPE for the net load, for every possible tare value.

zero.label: Zero-setting accuracy
zero.description: After zero setting, the effect of zero deviation on the weighing result must not exceed ± 0.25 e.

tilt.label: Tilting
tilt.description: Instrument tilted lengthwise and transversely to its limiting value. At no load the indication may shift by at most 2 e from the level position; at self-indication capacity and at Max the error must stay within the mpe after re-zeroing in the tilted position.

warmup.label: Warm-up time
warmup.description: After at least 8 h disconnected, the instrument is switched on, zeroed and loaded close to Max. The error, corrected for the zero error at that moment, is determined at switch-on and after 5, 15 and 30 minutes.

temperature.label: Static temperatures
temperature.description: Weighing tests at the reference temperature, the specified high and low temperatures, at 5 °C where the low limit is at or below 0 °C, and again at the reference temperature. Every error must be within the mpe.

temperatureZero.label: Temperature effect on no-load indication
temperatureZero.description: The zero indication is read at each test temperature. Between any two consecutive temperatures it must not change by more than one e per 5 °C (per 1 °C for class I).

voltage.label: Power supply voltage variation
voltage.loadHint: 10 e and a load between ½ Max and Max
voltage.description: The instrument is operated at the lower and upper voltage limits for its supply type. All functions must operate as designed and every indication must be within the mpe.

dampHeat.label: Damp heat, steady state
dampHeat.description: At least five loads at the reference temperature and 50 % RH, then at the specified high temperature and 85 % RH after two days of conditioning, then back at reference. Every indication must be within the mpe.

creep.label: Creep
creep.description: A load close to Max stays on the instrument. The indication may drift by at most 0.5 e during the first 30 minutes and by at most 0.2 e between minute 15 and minute 30; failing that, the drift over four hours must stay within the mpe.

zeroReturn.label: Zero return
zeroReturn.description: The zero indication before and after a load close to Max has rested on the instrument for 30 minutes may differ by at most 0.5 e.

spanStability.label: Span stability
spanStability.loadHint: near Max, the same weights throughout
spanStability.description: At least eight measurements near Max spread over up to 28 days around the performance tests. Each error must be within the mpe, and the errors may not differ from one another by more than half of e or half of the mpe, whichever is greater.

markings.label: Descriptive markings

items.label: Manufacturer's mark or full name
Accuracy class as a Roman numeral in an oval
Maximum capacity in the form Max …
Minimum capacity in the form Min …
Verification scale interval in the form e = …
Serial number
Name or mark of the manufacturer's agent (imported)
Software identification (software-controlled instruments)
Actual scale interval in the form d = … (when d < e)
Maximum additive tare effect in the form T = + …
Maximum subtractive tare effect in the form T = − …
Maximum safe load in the form Lim = …
Special temperature limits in the form … °C / … °C
Markings indelible, legible and grouped in a visible place

markings.description: Presence and form of the descriptive markings on the instrument or its data plate.

functional.label: Functional and construction checks

items.label: Printing and storage inhibited until stable equilibrium is reached
Combined zero-setting and zero-tracking range not more than 4 % of Max
Initial zero-setting range not more than 20 % of Max
Zero indicator shown when deviation from zero is within ± 0.25 e
Automatic zero-setting operates only at stable equilibrium, indication below zero for 5 s
Zero-tracking corrections not more than 0.5 d per second
Net value marked NET while a tare device is in operation
Tare device cannot be used at or below zero effect or above its maximum effect
No indication or transmission of a weighing result during warm-up
Interfaces cannot introduce instructions that falsify a weighing result
Level indicator with limiting mark fitted and visible (instruments liable to be tilted)
Display test on switch-on shows all relevant signs

functional.description: Design requirements verified by inspection and simple functional trials rather than by measurement.
